scriptedVariables.name: slackIssueKey
scriptedVariables.script: let root=scope;if(root&&typeof root.payload==='string'){try{root=JSON.parse(root.payload);}catch(e){root={};}}else if(root&&typeof root.payload==='object'&&root.payload!==null){root=root.payload;if(typeof root.payload==='string'){try{root=JSON.parse(root.payload);}catch(e){}}}const at=(o,p)=>{if(o==null||!p)return undefined;if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(o,p))return o[p];return p.split('.').reduce((c,k)=>{if(c==null)return undefined;if(/^\d+$/.test(k)&&Array.isArray(c))return c[Number(k)];return c[k];},o);};const read=(...ps)=>{for(const p of ps){const v=at(root,p);if(v!==undefined&&v!==null&&String(v).trim()!=='')return v;}return '';};return String(read('actions.0.value','actions.0.block_id','callback_id')).trim();

scriptedVariables.name: slackDecision
scriptedVariables.script: let root=scope;if(root&&typeof root.payload==='string'){try{root=JSON.parse(root.payload);}catch(e){root={};}}else if(root&&typeof root.payload==='object'&&root.payload!==null){root=root.payload;if(typeof root.payload==='string'){try{root=JSON.parse(root.payload);}catch(e){}}}const at=(o,p)=>{if(o==null||!p)return undefined;if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(o,p))return o[p];return p.split('.').reduce((c,k)=>{if(c==null)return undefined;if(/^\d+$/.test(k)&&Array.isArray(c))return c[Number(k)];return c[k];},o);};const read=(...ps)=>{for(const p of ps){const v=at(root,p);if(v!==undefined&&v!==null&&String(v).trim()!=='')return v;}return '';};const a=String(read('actions.0.action_id','actions.0.name')).toLowerCase();if(a.includes('approve'))return 'approve';if(a.includes('reject')||a.includes('deny'))return 'reject';return '';

actions.name: Approve Jira Work Item
actions.description: Run the approval transition when someone clicks Approve in Slack.

conditions.description: Only run for the Approve button.
The button value must carry a Jira work item key.
Skip until the approval transition ID is set.

actions.name: Reject Jira Work Item
actions.description: Run the rejection transition when someone clicks Reject in Slack.

conditions.description: Only run for the Reject button.
The button value must carry a Jira work item key.
Skip until the rejection transition ID is set.

actions.name: Record Slack Decision on Jira Work Item
actions.description: Add an internal Jira comment naming the Slack user who approved or rejected.

conditions.description: Only comment when a decision was recognised.
The button value must carry a Jira work item key.

actions.name: Replace Slack Message with Outcome
actions.description: Replace the original Slack message so the buttons cannot be clicked twice.

conditions.description: Only replace when Slack sent a response_url.
Only replace when a decision was recognised.
